svg.title: Archived JoBatea onboarding and search readiness low-fidelity desktop screens
svg.desc: This v0 design was superseded by the consolidated v1 workflow reference.
svg.text: Archived: onboarding and search readiness v0
Superseded by the consolidated Deep Job Search workflow v1.
This early exploration used large readiness panels for three states:
1. Missing resume: search blocked and Add resume is the primary action.
2. Resume ready: broad search is available and the wizard is recommended.
3. Wizard complete: refined profile and Start deep search are primary.
- A usable resume is required to search.
- Guided setup is optional, resumable, and editable.
- Broad search remains available with an explicit precision warning.
- Profile completion is advisory, not a judgement of candidate quality.
The active design replaces the large panels with a compact donut control,
adds generated guidance and run history, and connects the full user workflow.
See ../deep-job-search-workflow-v1-low-fi.svg for the active low-fidelity handoff.
